directory.about: What a client listed from the public connector directories is served: every tool but code, a generic executor. OpenAI: each model-callable operation is its own tool, with no generic executor enabling operations not individually exposed for review. Anthropic: each tool narrow and unambiguous, its annotations given (readOnlyHint, destructiveHint, title). Every grant names this profile until the owner names another.
sources: https://developers.openai.com/plugins/plugin-guidelines (Tools: Tool independence and exposure; Correct annotation), read 2026-11-03

custom.about: A client the owner named custom, such as one added as a custom connector: the owner's own choice of tools, the policy's tools.custom, or every tool when the policy names none.

run.about: A run's own MCP door, on the egress host (ADR-034 decision 6): every tool but the run tools, since work between agents is mail (decision 11).
